typography.heading: Fredoka, Bricolage Grotesque, or Cabinet Grotesk (Bubbly but bold and high-energy display font)
typography.notes: Must NOT be a generic AI font pairing. No Inter for headings. Use heavy weights (Black/ExtraBold) for headlines with tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for massive text. Keep 'CHICA DANCE' text condensed and uppercase like the brand requirement.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (grain) on dark backgrounds to give a 'studio rehearsal notebook' mixed with 'neon stage light' feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: Neon-pastel brutalism: Use hard borders (border-lavender or border-electric_blue) on dark cards instead of soft typical shadows.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use hard offset shadows (e.g., box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px var(--color-electric-blue)) on cards and buttons to simulate a sticker/notebook aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Sticker-like labels, offset collage frames, tilted micro-elements (rotate-[-3deg], rotate-[4deg]). Avoid rigid, all-straight-line layouts.

layouts.hero: Full-bleed kinetic hero feeling like a dance trailer, NOT a SaaS page. Headline: 'Stop Guessing. Start Training Like a K-pop Trainee.' Eyebrow: 'YOUR TRAINEE ERA STARTS HERE'. Include floating sticker labels ('TECHNIQUE. MUSICALITY. PERFORMANCE.') and animated 5-6-7-8 count markers staggering in. Add a 'Trainee Mode' collectible-pass badge.
layouts.grid_system: Use The 'Tetris' Bento Grid (Mode A) for sections. Wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12), asymmetrical column spans. Leave intentional negative space.
sections: Sticky Header: Nav (The Track, Meet Adina, Membership, FAQ) + CTA 'Join Trainee Track'. Must use glassmorphism (bg-deep_ink/80 backdrop-blur-xl). No fully transparent headers.
Problem/Cards: 3 irregular-shape energetic cards showing the problem of guessing.
Before/After: Shift comparison composition (layered offset frames).
Training Loop: 3-step loop (LEARN THE STANDARD / PRACTICE WITH PURPOSE / GET DIRECTION) with scroll reveals.
Founder Story: Adina's story with a portrait slot and a scrolling credibility ribbon (marquee).
Offer Section: 2 pricing cards. Primary: Trainee Track $20/mo. Secondary: Community Membership $5/mo.
Community Proof: 1,500+ dancers, collage format. CTA 'Meet the community inside Skool'. NO invented testimonials.
Audition-readiness: Editorial section with qualifier disclaimer.
Final CTA: Designed to feel like stepping onto a lit practice floor.
Footer: Disclaimer, contact email, Skool link.

motion.animations: Choreography-like transitions: Cards should slide, pivot, and settle like counts of eight. Use framer-motion staggerChildren. Use beat dots and mirrored-frame effects.
motion.accessibility: CRITICAL: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Wrap heavy animations in a useReducedMotion check.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over neon backgrounds uses deep_ink text. White text on deep_ink background. Meet WCAG AA minimum.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='join-primary-cta').

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write React components in JSX format (.jsx or .js). Do not use TypeScript types.
Prioritize using the uploaded brand images in /public if available. Fallback to provided unsplash URLs only if missing.
Implement 'Sticker-like' badges using absolute positioning, slight rotations (e.g. rotate-6), and bright pastel backgrounds with dark text.
Ensure 'Trainee Mode' feels like a visual world: use grid/notebook-like background lines softly in CSS, combined with glowing elements (drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(211,149,255,0.5)]).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT output generic 'AI slop' designs. We want bold, irregular, and memorable.
Never center-align the main app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Never use `transition: all`. Use specific transitions (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s, opacity 0.2s).
No emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
